method: Fresh source inspection; no new behavior test claimed by this receipt

findings.finding: Authority checked once before store scan, then claim/result/commit_sending/network/callback/completion can execute after blocking reads with no fresh fence.
findings.mitigation: Reuse the existing fenced delivery path; refresh authority after blocking observations and before each effect. Test lease expiry/revoke between each stage.

findings.finding: Automatic path converts uncertain store failures to ServiceError(original state); does not retain PendingOperation or enter writer HOLD. Failure/uncertain outcome commits are ignored with let _.
findings.mitigation: Reuse typed PendingOperation handling on every uncertain commit, preserve exact operation identity, refuse subsequent writers until actual cleanup/reconciliation.

findings.finding: Reads only first10 inbox rows without cursor, filters pending then stops. Ten terminal rows can permanently hide later pending work.
findings.mitigation: Bounded generation-coherent cursor scan or indexed pending queue; test more than10 completed rows followed by pending work.

findings.finding: Sends only first returned chunk. No drain of remaining chunks; completion attempted with singleton.
findings.mitigation: Bounded durable outbox traversal and per-chunk state; test multiple chunks and restart halfway.

findings.finding: Fabricates callback ID cb-query- plus request_id and ignores callback result; no captured actual callback identity.
findings.mitigation: Persist actual provider callback identity and acknowledge only real callback updates, with bounded truthful outcome.

findings.finding: One supervisor child with5/10 restart budget differs from adopted four-child rest_for_one3/5; automatic dispatch executes blocking chain inside control actor.
findings.mitigation: Implement adopted supervision/serialization and finite automatic loop, or obtain explicit independently reviewed equivalent design amendment. Test actual child failure topology and responsive cancellation.

findings.finding: Receipt contains database path and binary hashes but no store incarnation or prior service epoch; new registration verifies current incarnation without relating it to cleanup receipt.
findings.mitigation: Bind receipt to actual stopped registered writer, store incarnation and prior epoch. Refuse old receipt after database replacement and unrelated-unit cleanup.
